name: tax1099-payer
description: Create and update Payers in Tax1099 without sending TINs, and check pending Payer status. The TIN is entered by the user on the secure Tax1099 website.

interface.longDescription: Create or update Payers in Tax1099 without sending taxpayer identification numbers (TINs). New Payers are saved as pending and you receive a secure Tax1099 link where the TIN is entered after signing in. Then check whether the TIN has been entered and get the Payer's ID. Existing Payers can be updated by their TPID.
defaultPrompt: Use Tax1099Payer to add a new Payer.
Use Tax1099Payer to check if my pending Payer is complete.
Use Tax1099Payer to update an existing Payer's address.
